title: Inequality for Strong-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in Fermionic Open Quantum systems
summary: Under decoherence, an initial Gaussian (free-fermion) state evolves into a non-Gaussian mixed state, so the resulting decohered fermionic state is not exactly solvable in general. We show through an inequality that a class of Rényi-2 correlators of the decohered fermion state are upper-bounded by the Rényi-2 correlator serving as a proximate diagnostic of strong-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) of the charge-U(1) symmetry.
